hook: A loud wooden slam and a frantic, weeping girl rushing in to declare that her little brother is dying.
cliffhanger: Juliana resolves to take her herbal ledger and rush to save the dying child despite having lost everything.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a desperate child needs medical help and that institutional doctors have turned her away for lack of money.
narrative_context: Prudence begs Juliana to save her brother Toby after the apothecary and manor doctor reject them for having no silver.
promotional_strength: It highlights the contrast between aristocratic cruelty and the heroine's enduring compassion, immediately engaging the viewer with a high-stakes medical emergency.

evidence.observation: A loud wooden slam announces Prudence's frantic entrance.
Prudence reveals the apothecary shut the door in her face because they lack silver.
Juliana asserts her authority and prepares to save the boy.

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: We have no clinic now.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Despondent)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.

hook: Prudence expressing overwhelming gratitude to Juliana after her brother is saved.
cliffhanger: Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess inside the manor is mysteriously and secretly dying, ending on a dramatic musical swell.
standalone_clarity: A viewer can understand that a life has been saved and that a new, high-stakes medical mystery involving a powerful figure has just been uncovered.
narrative_context: After Toby recovers, Prudence warns Juliana about the arrogant manor residents, leading to the revelation about the Dowager Duchess's failing health.
promotional_strength: It bridges the village storyline with the overarching aristocratic conspiracy, creating a compelling hook for the next episode.

evidence.observation: Prudence praises Juliana for saving her brother where grand doctors failed.
Prudence reveals the Dowager Duchess is fading away from a mysterious illness.
Juliana realizes the gravity of the situation as dramatic strings swell.

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: She is dying, Lady Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.
